targets.ps1: validated; every expected decision executed once before its deadline, a recorded no-rebalance, or not expected under an operator pause

commands: GITHUB_REPOSITORY=mannoj93-spec/jbm-desk-data GH_TOKEN=<read token> python scripts/service_acceptance.py --from 2026-10-07T00:00:00Z --to 2026-10-08T00:00:00Z --save-evidence actions-2026-10-07.json [--timer-receipts receipts-2026-10-07.json]
rules: the window is not moved, shortened or re-declared after observation
a provider outage inside it is recorded and counts against it
if it fails, the result is kept and a retry is a new, separately declared window
restored or late data never counts
